raw_text: Every year on the Balakot anniversary Pakistan trots out the same narrative. This year they added 'new satellite imagery' but it's clearly cropped to exclude the impact zone documented by Reuters and Planet Labs in 2019. The coordinates don't even match the original target area. Same propaganda, slightly updated packaging.
clean_text: Reddit user debunks Pakistan's new Balakot satellite imagery claims. Notes coordinates don't match original target area and images exclude impact zone documented by Reuters and Planet Labs.
